air-bearing-and-air-caster.alt: Render of an air bearing: a round aluminium air pad with a dark porous face sits on a speckled granite surface plate, fed by a blue air hose at its side and carrying its load through a steel ball on top; a second pad lies upside down beside it, showing the porous face the air comes out of.

air-logic-valve.alt: Render of a shuttle valve, the simplest air-logic element, cut in half: inside a brass body a steel ball sits against one inlet seat, so air from the other inlet passes round it to the outlet on top; push-in fittings with blue and black air tubes are attached.

aluminium-extrusion-connectors.alt: Render of two silver 20 mm aluminium frame bars joined at a right angle by a cast corner bracket with black screws into the T-shaped grooves, with a loose slide-in T-nut and screw lying by the open end of the lower bar, whose T-slots show end-on.

annular-snap-fit.alt: Render of an annular snap fit: a 3D-printed cap snapped onto the end of a printed tube, cut open to show the raised ring round the tube sitting in a matching groove inside the cap; a second cap lies beside it.

anti-backlash-gear.alt: Render of an anti-backlash gear: a steel gear made of two thin halves stacked on one hub, the top half turned slightly against the bottom one by two small coil springs sitting in curved windows, so their teeth sit side by side out of step and pinch the teeth of a plain brass gear meshing beside it.

anti-twister-mechanism.alt: Render of an anti-twister demonstrator: a cable leaves a round fixed base beside a central shaft, loops out and up through a guide on a carrier arm half-way up, and comes back in under the middle of a spinning platform on top, so the platform can turn for ever without the cable twisting.

baked-in-findings.alt: Render of baked-in findings: a flat polymer-clay pendant with the top layer of clay cut away to show a gold eye pin baked inside, its end bent sideways so it cannot pull out and its loop sticking out of the top; beside it a clay stud earring lies face down, its post coming out of a second layer of clay pressed over the post's flat pad.

bent-or-twisted-tab-through-a-slot.alt: Render of a bent-tab and twist-tab joint: a steel sheet stands on edge under a blue painted metal sheet, and three tabs on its top edge come up through slots in the blue sheet; the first is just pushed through, the second is twisted a quarter turn and the third is folded flat, so neither of those two can pull back out.

bevel-splitter-and-counter-rotating-driv.alt: Render of a bevel splitter: a brass bevel gear on an upright input shaft meshes with two larger solid steel bevel gears facing each other on one horizontal line, each fixed by its hub to its own output shaft in printed bearing blocks, so the two outputs turn in opposite directions.

bidirectional-anti-back-drive-clutch.alt: Render of a two-way anti-back-drive roller clutch with its input part taken out: inside the fixed ring a square output hub has two steel rollers and a small spring on each flat, and beside it lies the input disc with four pins that slide into the gaps between the rollers, and its own shaft.

binding-plate-lock.alt: Render of a binding-plate lock like the one at the back of a caulking gun: a smooth steel rod passes through a steel bracket and then through a flat steel plate with a slightly oversized hole; a coil spring round the rod pushes the plate so it leans a few degrees and grips the rod.

bistable-compliant-mechanism.alt: Render of two identical one-piece 3D-printed bistable snap switches lying flat: in each, a frame holds a centre block on two thin pre-curved beams; in one the beams arch up and in the other they have snapped over to arch down.

bonding-fastener.alt: Render of a bonding fastener: a threaded steel stud welded to a thin, wide base plate full of holes, glued flat onto a carbon-fibre panel with no hole drilled, the glue squeezed up through the holes like little rivet heads; a second fastener lies beside it, tipped up to show its perforated plate.

capstan-cable-drive.alt: Render of a 3D-printed capstan cable drive: a thin rope wound four times round a small aluminium drum on a stepper motor runs along the rim of a large blue printed drum sector, with both rope ends clamped at the ends of the sector.

cardboard-screws-and-rivets.alt: Render of cardboard screws and rivets: two overlapping pieces of corrugated cardboard are held together by a chunky blue plastic screw and the round head of a white snap-together box rivet; in front lie a loose screw with its coarse thread and the two identical halves of a rivet with their ridged prongs.

clamp-on-accessory-mount-for-bars-poles-.alt: Render of a clamp-on accessory mount: a two-piece printed clamp squeezed round a short length of handlebar by two screws, with a black rubber pad between clamp and bar and two flat prongs on top for fixing a light or camera.

click-pen-mechanism.alt: Render of a click-pen mechanism, close up: the blue upper barrel of a retractable ballpoint pen is cut open to show the push button with saw teeth on its end, the white toothed rotator sitting on top of the ink refill, and the ribs inside the tube that catch the rotator; the clear lower barrel shows the refill.
click-pen-mechanism.note: weak: the toothed parts inside the cut barrel are hard to make out

compliant-detent.alt: Render of a 3D-printed compliant detent: a notched wheel with a grip knob turns on a printed base, and a thin springy arm printed as part of the base rests its rounded tip in one of the notches, so the knob clicks from position to position.

compliant-gripper-and-force-amplifier.alt: Render of a one-piece 3D-printed compliant gripper: two long plastic handles joined at one end by a thin U-shaped loop that bends instead of a pin, with short jaws near the loop pinching a wooden bead.

compliant-one-piece-latch.alt: Render of a 3D-printed box with a one-piece springy latch: a thin plastic beam printed as part of the lid hangs down the front, its hook clicked in under a small ridge on the box wall, with a tab at the bottom to lift and open it.

compression-limiter.alt: Render of a compression limiter: a 3D-printed bracket bolted to a painted steel plate, cut away to show a brass tube pressed into the bolt hole, a hair shorter than the plastic, so the bolt's washer rests on the tube instead of crushing the plastic; a second tube stands beside it.

cross-halving-slot-joint.alt: Render of a cross-halving slot joint: two laser-cut plywood strips, one slotted halfway down from the top and one halfway up from the bottom, pushed into each other to stand as a flush cross; a third strip lies flat beside them showing its slot.

crush-ribs-and-spring-fit-features.alt: Render of crush ribs: a 3D-printed plate with two holes for ball bearings, each hole lined with four narrow ribs running down its wall; a bearing is pressed into one hole and a second bearing lies beside the empty one, ready to push in.

detent-hinge.alt: Render of a black plastic detent hinge held open at a right angle, cut in half across its knuckle to show a spring in the fixed leaf pushing a steel ball into one of three notches in the moving leaf's round knuckle.

elastic-averaging.alt: Render of elastic averaging: a 3D-printed base with two square pockets lined with many thin springy fins; a printed block is pressed into one pocket, bending all the fins a little so it sits centred, and the other pocket is empty to show the fins.

electro-permanent-magnet.alt: Render of an electro-permanent magnet gripper: a small square circuit board with a capacitor and chips sits on a magnet block made of two iron pole pieces with a shiny neodymium bar and a copper-wound alnico bar between them, and the block is holding a steel plate.

exact-constraint-mounting.alt: Render of an exact-constraint (3-2-1) fixture on a 3D-printed plate: an aluminium block sits on three domed steel rest buttons, clear of the plate, with two steel pins touching its long side and one its end, while a spring plunger in a corner block pushes it into all six points.

face-ratchet.alt: Render of a face ratchet: two 3D-printed discs on a steel shaft with sloped saw teeth on their facing sides, the orange disc pushed against the grey one by a coil spring held by a washer and nut, and lifted part way up the tooth ramps as it is about to click into the next gap.

fin-ray-gripper.alt: Render of a fin-ray gripper holding a ball: two soft, printed, triangular fingers with a ladder of cross ribs inside stand on a gripper body, and each has curled its tip in around the ball instead of bending away from it.

flexible-beam-coupling.alt: Render of a flexible beam coupling: a short aluminium tube with a spiral slot cut through its middle and small grub screws at each end joins the shaft of a black stepper motor to a threaded leadscrew, as on a 3D printer.

folded-seam.alt: Render of a folded seam: two strips of thin galvanised steel sheet joined edge to edge, each edge folded into a hook, the hooks interlocked and hammered flat, with a small step so both sheets lie flat; the cut end shows the four layers trapping each other.

folding-box-closures.alt: Render of folding box closures: a green printed card carton stands with its top open, the two small dust flaps folded in and the closure panel swung up, with the rounded tuck flap on its edge ready to slide down inside the front wall.

four-bar-linkage.alt: Render of a four-bar linkage made from 3D-printed flat links: a short orange crank and a longer green rocker pivot on brass posts on a plywood base, joined across the top by a long blue coupler, with black screws as the four pivots.

friction-welded-plastic.alt: Render of a friction-welded plastic joint: two 3D-printed plates laid edge to edge with a rough melted bead of filament fused along most of the seam, the last part of the seam still open, and a short stub of filament with a worn, melted end lying beside them.

gearless-right-angle-drive.alt: Render of a gearless right-angle drive (Hobson's joint): two printed drums on shafts set at a right angle, linked by a ring of six L-shaped steel rods whose legs slide in holes in the faces of both drums, with the shafts held in printed bearing blocks on an L-shaped base.

glass-and-mirror-edge-clips-and-clamps.alt: Render of glass and mirror edge clips and clamps: on a piece of painted wall, a mirror is held by four small white plastic clips that overlap its edges, two carrying it at the bottom and two over the top, and below it a glass shelf is gripped by two chrome clamps lined with black rubber pads, with no holes in the glass.

glass-door-hinge.alt: Render of a glass door hinge: a small wooden cabinet with a glass door standing part open, the door held only by two chrome clamps gripping its top and bottom corners, each turning on a pin in the cabinet top and base, with a small magnetic catch on the base for the other corner.

glued-tab-joint.alt: Render of glued tab joints in card: a small blue papercraft cube with its lid open shows narrow tabs folded in along the top edges and behind the corners, ready for the lid to be glued down onto them; beside it a brown card tube has its end cut into short tabs that are folded out flat and glued to a card base.

granular-jamming-gripper.alt: Render of a granular jamming gripper: a latex balloon full of ground coffee, under a printed funnel on a small stand, has set hard round a ball and holds it just above the base, with a hose running to a small vacuum pump.

guy-line-slider.alt: Render of a three-hole guy-line runner on a taut tent line: the cord comes down from the tent, weaves through the holes of a small green aluminium plate, loops round a steel tent peg and comes back to end in a stopper knot, so sliding the plate along the line tightens it.
guy-line-slider.note: weak: the way the line threads through the three holes is a guess

half-nut.alt: Render of a half nut opened on a lead screw: a steel threaded rod runs between two end blocks, and the two bronze halves of the nut have slid apart on their guide rods so their half-threads no longer touch the screw.

heat-set-threaded-insert.alt: Render of a heat-set threaded insert: a printed plastic boss cut in half shows a knurled brass insert with an inner thread melted into it, its ridges locked into the plastic; a second insert lies beside it.

heat-staking.alt: Render of heat staking: a small green circuit board sits on a blue 3D-printed base, held at three corners by the base's own plastic posts melted into domed heads over the board's holes; at the fourth corner the post still sticks up straight through the hole, not yet melted.

housing-and-rebate-joints.alt: Render of housing and rebate joints in pine: a board lying flat has two shallow channels (housings or dados) cut across it and a step (rebate or rabbet) cut along its end; an upright board sits in one housing and another in the rebate, and the second housing is empty.

indexing-plunger.alt: Render of an indexing plunger screwed into a blue fixed bracket, cut in half to show the spring inside pushing its steel pin down into one of a row of holes in a sliding aluminium bar, with a black pull knob on top.

intermittent-gear.alt: Render of an intermittent gear pair: a 3D-printed driving gear with only three teeth and a smooth rim, and an output gear with four curved notches in its rim, on steel pins in a printed base; the driver's smooth rim sits in one notch, holding the output gear still until the teeth come round.

invisible-barrel-hinge.alt: Render of invisible barrel hinges: two wooden boards opened to a right angle, joined at their edges by two small brass hinges whose cylinders are sunk in holes drilled into the board edges, with only the folded brass links showing in the corner; a spare hinge, two brass cylinders joined end to end by short links, lies on the table beside them.
invisible-barrel-hinge.note: weak: the hinge itself is small in the frame; a photo of the hinge in a box edge would be much better

iris-valve.alt: Render of an iris valve: a fabric sleeve held between a fixed top ring on three posts and a bottom ring with a lever; the bottom ring has been turned, twisting the sleeve into a narrow hourglass waist that has nearly closed.

jaw-coupling.alt: Render of a jaw coupling pulled apart along its shafts: two aluminium hubs, one on a plain motor shaft and one on a leadscrew, each with three stubby jaws on its face, and a red rubber star-shaped spider between them whose six legs fill the gaps between the jaws.

keyless-locking-bush.alt: Render of a keyless locking bush, cut open by a quarter: a V-belt pulley sits on a plain steel shaft, held only by a dark steel bush in its bore; the cut shows the bush's two tapered rings wedged between shaft and pulley, with a ring of cap screws on its front flange.

kinematic-coupling.alt: Render of a kinematic coupling: a round black aluminium plate with three V-grooves pointing to its centre, each made of two steel pins, and a magnet in the middle; beside it the matching blue top plate lies upside down, showing the three steel balls that drop into the grooves.

knife-edge-and-jewel-pivots.alt: Render of a knife-edge pivot: a brass balance beam with a sharp triangular steel blade through its middle, the blade's lower edge resting in shallow V-grooves in two polished stone seats on top of two brass pillars, so the beam can rock almost without friction.

lamina-emergent-torsional-joint.alt: Render of a lamina emergent torsional joint in laser-cut plywood: one sheet with long slots cut along the fold line, its right panel folded up at an angle while the thin strips left between the slots twist to let it bend.

lead-came-joint.alt: Render of a lead came joint: a small leaded-glass panel of nine coloured and clear glass pieces held in grey H-shaped lead strips, with bright solder blobs only where the strips meet and dark cement along their edges; a short offcut of lead came lies in front, showing its H-shaped end.

lever-cam-panel-connector.alt: Render of a lever-cam panel connector: two wooden panels joined edge to edge, cut away round the joint to show the two lens-shaped plastic connector halves set in curved slots in each edge, and the metal lever swung across the joint, hooking them together.

lid-and-flap-stays.alt: Render of a folding lid stay: a small wooden chest with its lid open, held up by a brass stay inside the right-hand wall, its two flat arms locked straight at a riveted elbow, one end screwed to the wall and the other to the underside of the lid.

linked-lead-screws.alt: Render of linked lead screws: two upright lead screws each carry a brass nut under an aluminium bed, and at their feet the same toothed pulley on each screw is wrapped by one closed black timing belt that also runs round the pulley of a single stepper motor, so both screws turn together.

liquid-clay-bond.alt: Render of a liquid-clay bond in polymer clay: a small clay mushroom with a quarter cut away shows a thin, glossy layer of liquid clay between its red cap and cream stem, with a little bead squeezed out round the joint; beside it a second stem has a wet coat of liquid clay brushed on top, ready for its cap, and the brush lies in front.
liquid-clay-bond.note: weak: the liquid-clay layer shows only as a thin pale band under the cap, even drawn thicker than real

load-bearing-stitch-patterns-for-straps-.alt: Render of two nylon webbing straps sewn round steel D-rings: each strap passes round the ring, folds back on itself and is sewn down, one with a box-X stitch (a rectangle with an X through it) and the other with three zigzag bar tacks.

locating-pins-and-hole-and-slot.alt: Render of hole-and-slot location: an aluminium base with two steel dowel pins standing up from its top, and beside it the blue plate that fits on it, with a snug round hole for one pin and a slot pointing towards that hole for the other, plus two bolt holes.

magnet-joint.alt: Render of a magnetic joint on a 3D-printed box: small round magnets are set flush into the four corners of the box rim, and the lid, turned over beside it, has matching magnets in its corners that pull it shut and line it up.

magnetic-assisted-buckle.alt: Render of a magnetic buckle, open: the dark plastic socket half lies face up with its strap, showing a pocket with a round magnet and a small ledge; beside it the plug half lies face down with its strap, showing the hook tongue and the steel disc that the magnet pulls into the pocket.
magnetic-assisted-buckle.note: weak: a generic shape, not a recognisable magnetic buckle such as a Fidlock

magnetic-detent.alt: Render of a magnetic detent: a 3D-printed base with eight small disc magnets set flush in a ring round a centre peg, and its ridged knob lying upside down beside it with eight matching magnets in its underside, which line up with the base magnets when the knob sits on the peg.

mechanical-metamaterial-mechanism.alt: Render of a mechanical metamaterial mechanism: a one-piece flexible 3D print made of a grid of square cells, fixed at the left to a grey block; its braced cells stay square while an unbraced middle column leans over into parallelograms, so the braced block on the right has dropped down.

mid-print-embedding.alt: Render of mid-print embedding: a 3D-printed block with a corner cut away to show a steel hex nut sealed in a hex-shaped pocket inside the plastic, with a bolt hole above it; a second nut lies beside the block.

multi-material-interlock.alt: Render of a multi-material interlock: a 3D-printed bar that is rigid orange plastic at one end and soft black rubbery plastic at the other, with a checked band across the seam where small beams of each material reach into the other, crossing at right angles from layer to layer.

multi-stage-slide-rigging.alt: Render of a three-stage linear slide lift with continuous rigging: a single string runs from a motor-driven spool up over a pulley on the fixed base slide, down under a pulley on the first moving stage, up over its top pulley and down to an anchor on the second stage, which stands highest.

multi-turn-rotation-limiter.alt: Render of a travelling-nut turn limiter: a threaded steel shaft with a knob on one end runs between two aluminium end plates; a brass nut on the thread is kept from spinning by a steel guide rod through its top, and two black stop collars on the shaft mark where the nut stops at each end.

ortho-planar-spring.alt: Render of a 3D-printed ortho-planar spring: one flat plastic piece with an outer ring, a round centre platform and three thin curved legs joining them, lying on a bench.

panel-standoff.alt: Render of panel standoffs: a glass panel held about an inch clear of a painted wall by four stainless steel standoffs, the glass pinched between each barrel and its domed cap; one cap is pulled out to show the threaded stud that passes through the drilled hole in the glass.

parallel-fold-pop-up.alt: Render of a parallel-fold pop-up: a pale yellow card opened to a right angle inside a blue cover has three strips cut from its centre fold and pushed through, so they stand out as box-shaped steps of different sizes, with the holes they came from showing the cover behind.

parallel-leaf-spring-flexure.alt: Render of a parallel leaf-spring flexure: a one-piece green 3D-printed part, a base block and a platform joined by two thin upright blades; the platform has been pushed a little to one side, the blades bend into matching S shapes and the platform stays level.

pinned-glue-joint.alt: Render of a pinned glue joint: a grey plastic model figure cut in half shows a short brass pin set half into a drilled hole in its shoulder and half into a hole in its arm, both holes filled with glue around the pin; in front lies a spare arm with its pin already glued in and sticking out.

pneumatic-artificial-muscle.alt: Render of a pneumatic artificial muscle lying on the bench, inflated: an amber rubber tube swollen inside a black criss-cross woven sleeve, clamped at both ends in crimped aluminium ferrules, with a mounting eye at one end and a barbed air fitting and blue air tube at the other.

potted-insert.alt: Render of a potted insert: a piece of sandwich panel, two thin fibreglass skins over a balsa core, cut away to show a threaded metal insert set in a plug of hard epoxy that replaces the core round the hole and is glued to both skins; a bolt lies beside it.

printing-onto-fabric.alt: Render of 3D printing onto fabric: a sheet of teal hexagonal plastic scales printed through black see-through tulle, with the end of the sheet curling up because the bare net between the scales bends like a hinge.

pull-tab-and-slider-mechanism.alt: Render of a pull-tab slider in a card book: on the right-hand page a cut-out card boat sits over a long slot, fixed to a green card strip that slides in a channel behind the page, and the strip's rounded tab sticks out of the edge of the page, pulled part way out.

push-fit-rod-and-spar-fittings.alt: Render of push-fit kite fittings: carbon rods pushed into a red moulded cross connector, one spar half pulled out a little from its socket; lower down the spine is joined by an aluminium ferrule glued onto one rod with the other rod partly pulled out, and the rod ends carry a slotted nock and end caps.

push-on-edge-trim.alt: Render of push-on edge trim: a black U-shaped rubbery strip pushed onto the edge of an aluminium sheet, its cut end showing the metal clip moulded inside and the angled tongues gripping both faces of the sheet; the far end of the sheet edge is still bare.

push-push-latch.alt: Render of a push-push latch with its housing cut open: inside the white plastic body a black slider carries a heart-shaped track, a thin steel wire reaches into the track and rests in the notch at the top of the heart, a coil spring behind the slider pushes it outwards, and the plunger with a rubber tip sticks out of the front.

quarter-turn-fastener.alt: Render of a quarter-turn (Dzus-type) fastener, cut away: a button-headed stud through a painted panel and a steel frame tube, with a steel wire spring riveted inside the tube sitting in the stud's spiral slot; a second stud lies in front showing the spiral slot in its tip.

quick-release-hooks.alt: Render of a stainless steel pelican hook hanging from its eye: a curved hinged tongue loops round under a steel ring and its tip is held against the body by a sliding link, which is knocked off to let the tongue swing open and release the ring.
quick-release-hooks.note: weak: the pelican-hook shape is approximate (real tongues are flat, beak-shaped bars)

quick-release-pin.alt: Render of a quick-release pin holding a clevis together: a stainless pin with a push-button handle passes through two bracket lugs and the link arm between them, and two small steel balls stick out near its tip past the far lug to lock it in place; a split ring hangs from the handle.

ratchet-tooth-torque-limiter.alt: Render of a ratchet-tooth torque limiter: a 3D-printed torque-limiting knob taken apart, with an orange driven part carrying a ring of lopsided sawtooth teeth round a threaded stud, the grey knob shell lying upside down beside it with the matching teeth inside, and the coil spring that presses them together.

rigid-chain-actuator.alt: Render of a rigid chain actuator of the kind that opens windows: a slim aluminium box with a stainless steel chain sticking straight out of the middle of its side, its links locked into a stiff straight bar held out in the air, ending in a mounting bracket; a power cable leaves one end.

rolling-contact-joint.alt: Render of a rolling-contact joint: two 3D-printed blocks with rounded ends, one lying flat and one rolled up at an angle, held together only by crossed black nylon straps screwed to their faces, the middle strap passing one way between the blocks and the two outer straps the other way.

rotary-latch.alt: Render of a rotary latch with its cover plate left off: on a metal housing plate with a slot, a dark steel claw has turned round a striker pin to trap it at the bottom of the slot, and a pawl rests in a notch on the claw to stop it turning back; the striker pin stands out from a bracket behind.

servo-or-motorised-latch.alt: Render of a servo latch: a printed box cut in half shows a small blue hobby servo whose white arm pushes a steel bolt, through a wire link, along two guide blocks and through a screw eye hanging from the closed lid, so the lid is locked; a small controller board lies on the floor of the box.

several-motors-driving-one-load.alt: Render of several motors driving one load: two identical stepper motors bolted behind an upright clear acrylic plate each turn a small steel pinion, and both pinions mesh with one large printed gear between them that turns a winch drum wound with cord.

shape-memory-alloy-wire-latch.alt: Render of a shape-memory-alloy wire latch: a 3D-printed lid hinged on a post is held shut by a catch lever whose nib sits in a notch in the lid's lip, pushed in by a small spring, with a thin nitinol wire running from the post to the catch, ready to pull it free when current warms it.

shear-pin-coupling.alt: Render of a shear-pin coupling: a steel gear and its hub on a shaft, with the hub and shaft cut in half to show the brass cross pin that joins them, narrowed where the hub meets the shaft so that it snaps there if the gear jams; a spare pin lies in front.

shock-corded-sectional-pole.alt: Render of a shock-corded tent pole joint pulled apart: two aluminium pole sections lie end to end, the left one with a silver sleeve (ferrule) on its end, and the black elastic cord running inside them shows in the gap, ready to pull the right-hand tube back into the sleeve.

slot-in-model-hinge.alt: Render of slot-in model hinges: the back edge of a balsa model plane wing and its aileron joined by thin white flat hinges pushed half into a slit in each part and glued, with the aileron swung down so the hinges bend in the gap between the bevelled edges; the cut end shows one hinge buried in both slits, and a spare hinge lies in front.
slot-in-model-hinge.note: weak: at page size the hinges show only as small white tabs in the gap; the slits they sit in are hard to see

snap-lock-sheet-joint.alt: Render of a snap-lock sheet joint: a small laser-cut acrylic bridge, two blue side walls holding a white top; on each wall a tab and a thin springy finger poke up through a slot in the top, and the little barb on the finger hooks over the top face so it cannot lift off.

snap-pin.alt: Render of a snap pin: two round 3D-printed parts held together by a split plastic pin, both parts cut away to show the pin's two legs passing through the hole with their barbs sprung out behind a shoulder inside the lower part; a second pin lies beside them.

soft-pneumatic-bending-actuator.alt: Render of a soft pneumatic bending actuator: a pale blue cast-silicone finger lying on its side, its row of swollen air chambers pushed apart so the finger curls round towards its flat base layer, with its root held in a grey printed mount fed by a blue air tube.

speed-control-valve.alt: Render of speed-control valves: a small round air cylinder with an elbow-shaped speed controller screwed into each of its two ports, each with a blue air tube pushed into its side and a small adjusting screw with a locknut on top.

split-part-joints-for-large-prints.alt: Render of split-part joints for a large print: a big round printed shape cut in two, the lower piece with two round pegs standing up from its flat cut face and the domed upper piece resting upside down beside it, showing the two matching holes the pegs fit into.

spring-powered-paper-pop-up.alt: Render of spring-powered paper pop-ups: a yellow card cube stands open with a rubber band stretched across its inside between two opposite corners; beside it a second cube is pressed flat, its band stretched between the folded ends, ready to snap it back into a cube; to one side a paper spring of two strips folded over each other holds up a card star.

stretch-release-adhesive-strips.alt: Render of a stretch-release adhesive strip holding a plastic hook on a painted wall: the white foam strip is sandwiched between the wall and the hook's back plate, with its plain pull tab hanging out below, ready to be pulled straight down along the wall.

structural-acrylic-and-low-surface-energ.alt: Render of a glued lap joint between two slippery plastic strips, a dark grey polyethylene one and a blue polypropylene one, held by a thin yellowish layer of two-part structural acrylic glue that has squeezed out a little at the edges of the overlap; behind them lies the glue’s twin cartridge with its long mixing nozzle.

t-slot-joint.alt: Render of a T-slot joint in laser-cut plywood: a top panel rests on a front panel whose tabs poke through it, and two T-shaped cut-outs in the front panel each hold a square nut; one screw is done up through the top into its nut, and the other lies beside its hole, ready to go in.

tape-spring-hinge.alt: Render of a tape-spring hinge: a short strip of yellow steel tape-measure blade joins two grey 3D-printed blocks, clamped to each under a metal plate with two screws; the hinge is folded to a right angle, the tape curved across its width in the straight parts and bent into a flat kink at the fold.

telescoping-tube-twist-lock.alt: Render of a twist-lock pole joint, cut away: a thin aluminium tube slides inside a wider blue tube; on its end a plastic plug carries a threaded rod with a cone that has been screwed into a red split expander sleeve, swelling it out to press on the inside of the outer tube.

threadless-ball-screw.alt: Render of a threadless ball screw: a smooth steel rod turned by a stepper motor passes through a 3D-printed nut whose two orange plates hold three ball bearings on bolts, pressed against the rod and tilted slightly so they roll round it in a spiral and drive the nut along.

tolerance-ring.alt: Render of a tolerance ring: a thin band of spring steel with a row of bumps, curled round a steel shaft and just started into the gap between the shaft and the bore of an aluminium hub, ready to be pushed in; the ring has a small split.

torque-limiting-gear-with-flexing-spring.alt: Render of a torque-limiting gear: a one-piece 3D-printed gear lying flat with an open middle, where three thin curved spring arms reach in from the rim and press their tips against a steel shaft, gripping it by springiness alone.

torsional-snap-fit.alt: Render of a torsional snap fit on a 3D-printed box: a rocker arm on the side of the box is held on a thin bar between two lugs, with its hook over the edge of the lid and a ridged press pad below the bar that tips the hook clear when pressed.

twisted-and-coiled-polymer-muscle.alt: Render of a twisted-and-coiled polymer muscle on a small test stand: a nylon fishing line twisted into a tight coil like a phone cord, with a thin heater wire wound along it, hangs from the stand’s arm by a crimped end and holds up a brass weight; red and black leads carry current to its ends to heat it.

twisted-string-actuator.alt: Render of a twisted-string actuator: a small gearmotor on a printed bracket turns a hub tied to two orange braided strings; the strings are twisted tightly round each other and pull a printed carriage along two steel guide rods towards the motor.

v-fold-pop-up.alt: Render of a V-fold pop-up: a white card opened out wide inside a green cover has a red card piece folded down its middle and glued to both pages at a slant, so that its middle crease stands up and leans towards the viewer, with all three creases meeting at one point on the centre fold.

v-groove-fold.alt: Render of a V-groove fold in foam board: a strip of board folded up into a neat right-angled corner, the two sloping cut faces of the groove glued together inside it and the uncut paper skin wrapping round the outside corner; in front lies a flat piece with a V-shaped groove cut almost through it, ready to fold.

vacuum-driven-artificial-muscle.alt: Render of a vacuum-driven artificial muscle: a strip of orange card folded into a zigzag lies sealed inside a clear plastic bag, with a blue drinking straw glued into one end of the bag with hot glue so the air can be sucked out.

virtual-pivot-linkage.alt: Render of a virtual-pivot linkage: on an aluminium base bar, two 3D-printed side links angled towards each other carry a T-shaped printed coupler, joined by small screws at four pivots, so the coupler turns about an empty point beyond the end of its stem where the lines through the two side links would cross.

wave-and-disc-springs.alt: Render of wave and disc springs: a stack of six dark cone-shaped disc springs on a bolt between flat washers, a quarter cut away to show them facing alternately in a zigzag, with a shiny multi-turn wavy flat-wire wave spring standing beside it and a single wave washer lying flat in front.

wedge-dowel.alt: Render of wedge dowels: a wooden side panel standing on edge with two keyhole-shaped slots in its face, and a shelf lying beside it with two ribbed dowels sticking out of its edge, lined up with the round ends of the slots, ready to be pushed in and slid along until they wedge tight.

wrap-spring-clutch.alt: Render of a wrap-spring clutch with a quarter cut away: two steel hubs of the same size set end to end on separate shafts, the lower one driven by a brass gear, with a tight coil spring wrapped over both so that turning the input the winding way grips the output and turning it back lets it slip.
